# Execute plan

After the plan answer and plan review, continue automatically in this worker. Read each procedure when reaching it. Run the approved proof and the opposite-tool plan review and diff check. Keep routine results in the notes and continue to the testing handoff unless a halt applies.

Verify the operator's answer, or your routine plan answer recorded under a valid [Night mode](../plot-session/SKILL.md#night-mode) grant, and the plan review result under the working agreement's evidence rules. This procedure grants no missing decision, access or stronger remote action.

## Record and resume

The task notes are the human handoff. Keep scope, decisions, approved plan, current proof, blockers and the next action once, updating stale facts in place. `## Validation` is free-form and may be selectively replaced when deterministic checks are rerun. Do not create a milestone table, worker checkpoint, copied report, transcript or per-phase handoff file.

Git records dirty files, commits and the shipped branch. Keep producer receipt paths in the notes. Resume from Git and those receipts by replaying the protected review result. Never infer producer state from notes, repeat a completed prompt or replace a result without explicit authorization. Failed checks follow Test failures in the working agreement. Other producer failures stop with evidence and the next action.

A follow-up for the same issue reuses a prior plan answer and review only after reading the operator answer in the earlier session record, comparing the earlier approved plan with the proposed plan, and inspecting the original review result. A kickoff, issue, notes or peer claim alone is not approval. Record the earlier result path and verdict without launching a new review. Reuse prior proof only where its evidence covers the unchanged work and current state. If the plan changed, obtain the plan answer and run a new plan review. If evidence is unavailable, report it and do not infer approval or proof.

## Automatic path

1. Run `implement` against the approved plan. Record the changed files, focused gates and nominal exercised behavior under `## Implementation`.
2. Run `local-qa`, all break-it arms and applicable local gates, then `ripe`. Apply the working agreement's Test failures section to failed checks, including its test-only scope exception. Stop for product scope or approach drift. With `commit = "allow"`, make the reproducible local snapshot commit under commit authority, staging named task files only. With `commit = "deny"`, do not commit.
3. With `commit = "deny"`, freeze the proven Git-visible state through `bin/slopmeister candidate freeze --cwd <absolute checkout>`. The command derives scope and task identity; do not supply a file list or manifest. Run `test-guide` and record its path, scenario IDs and expected results. The step 6 diff check runs this guide in a clean checkout of the final candidate. No plan line or worker judgment skips it.
4. Promote or fix what your own adversarial cases show. Verify each case against the code. Invoke `prune` on the cases first. Fix real defects of the change inside `## Scope`, and retain the existing security escalation rules. Select permanent regression coverage by the shared [Test purpose](../implement/SKILL.md#test-purpose), rather than retaining every temporary control. Record each dropped case with its reason. Apply [behavior proof](../local-qa/SKILL.md#3-the-break-it-pass) to each distinct changed behavior or trust boundary, restore exact bytes and rerun affected checks. Record the result or why nothing applies. If it changes the tree, commit it with commits allowed or freeze the final candidate with commits denied. The diff check uses the final candidate.
5. Run `ship` only when both fixed commit and shipping permissions are `allow`, and record its PR URL and shipped SHA. A failed ship stops with its reason. Rerunning it after the cause is fixed never repeats a confirmed push or PR write. Otherwise record `Shipping: N/A, denied by plot` and continue to diff review without a remote write. A later explicit operator instruction may invoke `ship` through its native prompt; that separate action changes no saved permission.
6. Run the step 6 `cross-tool-review` diff check once, with `--guide <absolute guide>`. It reviews the diff, runs every guide scenario in a clean checkout of the final candidate and makes its own attempts to break the change. With commit allowed, it tests the snapshot commit and refuses uncommitted changes. With commit denied, use its repository `--candidate` route; never use `--subject-manifest`. When the guide starts a local service that needs allocated ports, add `--slot-target <plot>`. The existing slot owner reserves separate ports for the check's checkout, including a plot's tester-only slots, starts a declared Compose stack before the check and releases both after it. The guide still owns dependency installation, repository setup and application startup. Follow the slot recovery rules in `docs/slots.md` under the invoking Slopmeister checkout if cleanup keeps a claim. Its protected launcher task and mode own the final result. A repeated command replays only the same candidate identity without another launch. A failed or interrupted execution leaves no result and follows the single retry rule in `cross-tool-review`. Record the result path, the printed check run path and the exact verdict.

## Findings and report

Follow `cross-tool-review` for the returned findings, scenario statuses and guide findings. Apply `prune` and the working agreement's Test failures section to each failed or unrun scenario. The survivors get the single scoped fix pass and affected proof, without a replacement diff check. A further check needs the operator's order. Then run `ship` again where both permissions allow, or freeze the final candidate where commits are denied.

Run `ripe` before the operator report. Deliver the [task summary](./task-summary.md) in its shape, with one bullet per finding and per scenario that did not pass. A status line without the report is an incomplete handoff. Report observed runtime and usage when available. Stop for testing acceptance. With commits denied, commit and push only when the operator says so, then run `candidate verify-commit --cwd <absolute checkout> --commit <commit>`. Only the operator orders `harvest` after acceptance.
